Teach

For instructors

A ready 45-minute class on risk and return. Students need only a browser.

What students learn

  • Sharpe ratio: return per unit of risk, above cash.
  • Diversification: why funds that don’t move together lower risk.
  • Money- vs time-weighted return: how deposit timing changes it.

The session

  1. 0–5 min: frame. Two portfolios both returned 8%. Are they equal?
  2. 5–15 min: sample. Read the sample student together.
  3. 15–30 min: Sharpe lesson. Students step through How Sharpe works.
  4. 30–40 min: change the portfolio. In pairs, change the weights, predict risk and return, then check.
  5. 40–45 min: debrief. What did a high return hide? Why is short history a weak guide?

What students need

No install, account or personal data. Nothing is uploaded.

Caveats to say out loud

Monthly data, before taxes and costs, US-listed funds only.
